sources: https://www.recreation.gov/camping/campgrounds/231837 (facility record, notices, rules, rate table and campsite catalog via the public api/camps endpoints, read 2026-11-21)
Esri World Imagery with the rec.gov per-site coordinates plotted (sites 002-021)

hookups.source: recreation.gov 231837 ('electrical hook-ups are not available'; notice 'Drinking water is available but you CANNOT hook up for filling'); catalog: every site STANDARD/TENT ONLY NONELECTRIC

sites.source: recreation.gov campsite catalog 231837: sites 002-021 (19 standard nonelectric, 014 tent-only) plus one MANAGEMENT site; Max Vehicle Length 32-83 ft, most 45-60

facilities.source: fs.usda.gov page ('picnic tables, campfire rings, vault toilets, and drinking water'; 'Water is turned off from about Oct. 1 through May 15'); rec.gov amenities

values.note: The main campground is gated about Oct 1 to mid-May; the six sites outside the gate stay open first-come, without water.

season.source: fs.usda.gov page ('Sites outside the main campground gate will remain open'; 'During the off-season, the right side of the campground (6 sites, 1 vault toilet) and the day use area are open ... on a first come basis'); rec.gov notice ('During the off season (from 10/01 until 5/15) the USFS operates this campground')

values.note: Reservable mid-May through Sep 30 (concessionaire season), up to 2 days ahead. Off-season sites are first-come, paid in cash at the iron ranger or by Scan & Pay on the Recreation.gov app.

booking.source: recreation.gov 231837 rate table (Peak Season 2026-05-16..2026-09-30, 2027-05-15..2027-09-30; First-come season 2026-04-15..05-15), rules reservationCutOff 2; FS page ('October through May: $15 first come first serve, pay in cash at iron ranger or through scan and pay on Recreation.gov app')

values.note: $30 a night in season; $15 at the off-season sites outside the gate. A car towed behind the RV is not an extra vehicle. Pets $2 each a night.

fees.source: recreation.gov rates (all site types $30, 2025-2028 seasons) and notices ('additional vehicle fee of $6.00 per night on the second vehicle ... provided these vehicles are not joined to the first vehicle by a hitch and towed'; 'A pet fee of $2 per pet per night'); FS page ('October through May: $15')

note: Forest Service campground in ponderosa pine and aspen on the south side of Bismarck Lake, beside the Custer State Park west entrance on US-16A east of Custer. A shoreline trail with a boardwalk and fishing piers; non-motorized boating. Generators 6 AM-10 PM. --Claude
summary: rec.gov + FS read: 20 non-electric sites (19 RV-capable, 32-83 ft), water but no fill-up, vault toilets; $30 reservable mid-May-Sep 30 via ExplorUS, 6 sites outside the gate open off-season first-come $15. Stored note had the lake on the wrong side; pin ~570 m S of the loops. Not waterfront kept (closest sites ~45-70 m through continuous pine).
flags: PIN: stored 43.77000,-103.51050 is ~570 m S of the camping loops; rec.gov site centroid 43.7751,-103.5110 (FS page gives 43.7755,-103.5120). Move to ~43.7751,-103.5110.
